## Where

Page / component / section affected. e.g. Home — The Archive grid.

## Current state

What it looks like today. A screenshot is ideal.

## Proposed change

What should be different, and why.

## Design intent check

The project deliberately avoids the generic AI-website look: gradients,
pill buttons, glass effects, bento grids, excessive rounding. How does this
change serve the museum × editorial × archive direction instead?

## Reduced motion / accessibility

Does the change respect `prefers-reduced-motion`, keyboard navigation, and
contrast? If it introduces motion, is it slow and deliberate?

- [ ] Works on mobile and desktop
- [ ] Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`
- [ ] Maintains or improves accessibility
